name: Image
text: Create or transform raster images. Open, crop, resize, and generate thumbnails with bounded dimensions and aspect ratio rounding. Cropping returns a new raster; thumbnail changes its image object in place.

name: ImageChops
text: Compare or combine pixel channels with difference, blend, composite and arithmetic. Most operations take one or two images and return a new image. Most are limited to 8-bit data with clipped results.

name: ImageCms
text: Manage color profiles with LittleCMS2. Build or apply ICC transforms between profiles and image modes, choose rendering intent or soft proof. Requires compatible profiles and modes; pixel color conversion has no display layout contract.

name: ImageColor
text: Parse CSS-style color names, hexadecimal RGB or RGBA, and numeric color forms. getrgb returns channel values including alpha when encoded. getcolor converts for an image mode. Unsupported color syntax raises ValueError.

name: ImageDraw
text: Draw paths, text, and shapes onto a Pillow raster. Coordinates clip at image bounds. Default drawing replaces pixels; translucent blending depends on image and draw modes or a separate overlay.

name: ImageEnhance
text: Adjust color balance, brightness, contrast, or sharpness by a factor. The method returns an enhanced image and factor one gives an original copy. It changes pixel appearance within the same raster extent.

name: ImageFile
text: Feed bytes incrementally to a Pillow Parser and close to obtain the decoded image. Also exposes codec support and plugin classes. Data must form a supported image stream; decoding is distinct from editing output.

name: ImageFilter
text: Apply predefined or configurable raster filters including blur, sharpen, rank and lookup table filters. Image.filter consumes the filter and yields processed pixels. Kernel or mode choices constrain supported operations.

name: CSV Import
text: Read or write CSV in DuckDB. Configure header, delimiters, schema, null padding or error handling; CSV type options differ between read_csv and COPY. store_rejects skips faulty lines and records them.

name: CSV Auto Detection
text: Infer CSV dialect, column types, and header from a sample. Inspect a proposed configuration with sniff_csv or override options in read_csv. Compressed streams and stdin constrain sampling to the beginning.

name: Reading Faulty CSV Files
text: Keep a CSV import running when rows are malformed. ignore_errors skips failures; store_rejects records bad lines and context in temporary tables. Projection and type choices can prevent an expected error from occurring.

name: CSV Import Tips
text: Import tricky CSV by forcing a header, supplying names or types, or using COPY against an existing schema. union_by_name aligns multiple file schemas. These options operate in the reader, subject to file layout.

name: SELECT Clause
text: Project the result columns and computed values. SELECT star EXCLUDE drops named columns from output; DISTINCT collapses returned duplicates. Projection occurs after FROM and filtering, and does not rewrite the source table.

name: FROM and JOIN Clauses
text: Choose query input and combine datasets with FROM, JOIN or a subquery. Supports table functions and joins with different unmatched-row behavior. Output projection and physical deletion belong to other statements.

name: WHERE Clause
text: Filter query rows after choosing the FROM source. Conditions can select a subset by equality, LIKE or ILIKE. A SELECT WHERE predicate only controls result membership and does not delete stored rows.

name: GROUP BY Clause
text: Combine rows by shared column values and compute aggregates. GROUP BY ALL derives grouping keys from nonaggregate SELECT columns. It changes result granularity and cannot retain a one-row-per-source-row view in general.

name: CSS Images Module Level 3
text: Fit replaced image content to a browser box. object-fit contain preserves aspect ratio inside the box; cover fills and clips overflow. Layout size, visible sampling and source raster bytes remain separate.

name: CSS Display Module Level 3
text: Control how document elements generate rendered boxes. visibility hidden suppresses rendering while retaining layout; display none suppresses box generation. Descendants may override inherited visibility. The rules concern browser presentation rather than deleting source data.

name: Metadata Vocabulary for Tabular Data
text: Annotate published tables with columns, datatypes, dialect and conversion metadata. suppressOutput can omit a column from generated output. Source values and columns still exist, and a conversion consumer must apply the annotation.

name: MapLibre Style Spec v8
text: Set map layer source, filter and visibility. A filter draws only features matching its expression; layout visibility can hide a layer. Features stay in the source, and zoom expressions in filters use integer zoom.
